name: listUsers
description: Lists users, one page at a time (response has `count` and `nextPage`). Corresponds to GET /api/users/v1/users. Requires `users:read` scope. Deactivated users are only listed with archived=true. [READ-ONLY]

filter.description: OData filter on id, badgeId, name/full, email/verified, globalRoleId or workspaceRoleAssignments, e.g. badgeId eq 'JS001'. Quote values with single quotes.

archived.description: List deactivated items instead of active ones.
